title: Forbidden Grounds Crisis
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji stepped into the Heavenly Realm passage, a will beyond words suddenly descended, and that familiar yet terrifying aura froze him completely—the Eye of Heavenly Dao, it was actually waiting for him here.

text.content: Ling Yuan's words "We are one family" exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea like thunder. His body shuddered, fingertips unconsciously digging into his palm as blood seeped through the gaps. The shock of the bloodline truth had not yet subsided when another heavy blow struck. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, forcefully suppressing that wild killing intent deep in his eyes, while his face displayed only bewildered terror. "Senior... what are you saying?" His voice trembled slightly, his acting impeccable. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment convulsed violently, as if warning of something. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out, his ethereal face showing unprecedented solemnity: "Be careful. He can invade your Mental Sea directly, which means his understanding of the Tianji Record runs far deeper than you imagined."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, your heartbeat is accelerating." Ye Qing's voice came from behind, carrying a hint of scrutiny. "And there's an unfamiliar spiritual sense fluctuation—who?" She stepped closer, demonic path mist silently spreading to envelop Chen Ji. "In my mist, you don't need to worry about eavesdropping." Those妖异的 purple eyes stared directly at him. "Did Ling Yuan contact you? What did he say?"

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then lowered his voice: "He said... we are one family." Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply. The next instant, she grabbed Chen Ji's wrist and pulled him deeper into the mist. "One family?" Her voice dropped extremely low. "Are you sure he wasn't being sarcastic or threatening?" Chen Ji shook his head, describing in detail the blood resonance he felt in his Mental Sea.

Ye Qing's expression turned extremely grim. She released Chen Ji's wrist and paced in the mist, then suddenly turned back: "Chen Ji, do you have a turtle-shell-shaped magical artifact on you?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, instinctively pressing his chest. There, the Tianji Record Fragment was slightly warming. He didn't speak, but Ye Qing had already read his reaction. "I knew it." She gave a bitter smile. "That thing... is not a creation of the mortal world."

"What do you mean?" Chen Ji's voice grew heavy. Mo Xiansheng's voice also rang in his heart: "Tell her. This woman might know more than you do." Ye Qing took a deep breath, a complex light flickering in her purple eyes: "In the secret records of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, there is a passage about the ancient era. The turtle shell artifact, also called the 'Tianming Turtle Shell,' is one of the objects that fell from the Heavenly Realm to the mortal world. Its function is—" She paused, as if choosing her words carefully. "Recording Heavenly Fate."

Chen Ji's heart sank violently. Tianming Turtle Shell—recording Heavenly Fate? How similar this was to the function of the Tianji Record! Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled intensely: "As I suspected... the Tianji Record is not an independent artifact. It and the Tianming Turtle Shell were originally one body..." Ye Qing noticed Chen Ji's unusual reaction but did not pursue it, simply continuing: "The secret records also state that a great catastrophe occurred in the Heavenly Realm, and numerous artifacts fell to the mortal world. Among them, the most precious is this 'Tianming Turtle Shell'—it is said to connect the passage between the Heavenly Realm and the mortal world."

dialogue.content: Just then, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a rare urgency: "Boy, take out the turtle shell." Chen Ji frowned: "Now?" Mo Xiansheng said: "Right here. Let her see too—if she knows these things, she should know what comes next." Chen Ji hesitated for a moment, then took out an ancient-looking turtle shell artifact from his chest. The surface shimmered with flowing inscriptions and a faint silver light. The moment Ye Qing saw it, her entire body shook violently: "This is... a complete Tianming Turtle Shell? No, its form is incomplete—could it be self-repairing?"

choice.prompt: The turtle shell artifact trembled slightly in his hand, and Chen Ji sensed a certain summons—something deep within the Forbidden Grounds seemed to be calling out to this relic from the Heavenly Realm.

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to peer into the source of the summons

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the turtle shell in his palm, and the power of the Tianji Record quietly operated. With a flash of silver light, he saw it—the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds, an altar sealed for ten thousand years was slowly awakening. At its center, a stone door covered in Heavenly Dao inscriptions stood half-open, behind which churned rolling heavenly flames and endless Void. Four large characters were carved on the door: "Path to Immortality." He saw himself wandering before the door, saw Ye Qing blocked outside, and saw an existence beyond all perception watching him from beyond the door—that gaze cold, scrutinizing, carrying condescending pity. Chen Ji猛地睁开眼，冷汗已浸透后背。Mo Xiansheng said heavily: "What did you see?"

choices.visible_reward: Deepen the trust relationship with Ye Qing

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head and tucked the turtle shell back into his chest: "Ye Qing, you said the Tianming Turtle Shell connects to the Heavenly Realm passage—what does this mean?" Ye Qing was slightly startled, then understood his intention. She did not refuse, but instead showed a hint of appreciation: "You're quite composed." She took the turtle shell, her fingertips gently stroking the inscriptions upon it, her brow furrowing more and more tightly: "These inscriptions... are not ordinary Heavenly Dao script. They are 'Destiny Path Inscriptions,' readable only by those recognized by Heavenly Fate. And you..." She looked at Chen Ji, an unusual light flickering in her eyes. "You can use it, which means you have already been noticed by the Heavenly Realm."

choices.text: Venture alone into the Forbidden Grounds to investigate

text.content: "No more waiting." With that, Chen Ji's figure flickered and he rushed into the depths of the Forbidden Grounds. Ye Qing let out a startled cry, wanting to stop him but it was already too late: "You're mad!" Her voice echoed behind him, but Chen Ji seemed not to hear at all. The turtle shell on his chest grew hotter and hotter, that summoning becoming increasingly intense, as if an invisible hand was pulling him. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out urgently: "Be careful! The aura ahead is not right—that is..." Before he could finish, Chen Ji had passed through the final stone wall, and the scene before him made him freeze completely.

Regardless of the path chosen, the scene before him stole his breath. Deep within the Forbidden Grounds stood an enormous altar, its circumference spanning a hundred zhang. Constructed from pure white jade, it bore intricate Heavenly Dao inscriptions that softly glimmered. At its center rose a massive stone gate, ten zhang tall, half-open, with blinding golden light seeping through its cracks. Above the gate, four ancient characters shone brilliantly—"通往仙界之路"—a portal connecting the celestial realm to the mortal world.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing caught up, her expression mirroring his initial shock. "This is... the celestial realm ruins?" Her voice trembled slightly. "I've never encountered a complete record of this in the Holy Sect's secret archives... So the legendary 'Path to Ascension' truly exists." She turned to Chen Ji, her violet eyes swirling with complex emotions. "Chen Ji, do you comprehend its significance? The entrance to the heavens... once opened—" She paused, her meaning hanging unspoken.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent, his gaze fixed on the half-open stone gate. The turtle shell against his chest felt like it would sear through his flesh. Mo Xiansheng's voice resonated again, carrying an unprecedented gravity: "Listen carefully, young one. Beyond this gate truly lies the celestial realm. Yet what you now witness is merely a projection—the genuine portal remains sealed. The key to its activation..." he hesitated, "resides in your very hands."

At this moment, a low, resonant rumble emanated from the gate's depths. The golden radiance within the door's crack intensified abruptly, and an immense, boundless pressure gushed forth like a tidal wave. Chen Ji felt his entire body tense, as if invisible eyes were meticulously scrutinizing him. That gaze bore no emotion—cold, ethereal, transcendent—representing an existence beyond mortal comprehension. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul quivered intensely: "Trouble... it has detected you!"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The prophetic vision returned to him—that entity surpassing all perception, observing him from beyond the gate. Could this be the legendary "Eye of Heavenly Dao"? Ye Qing similarly sensed the overwhelming pressure. Her complexion instantly turned deathly pale, instinctively positioning herself before Chen Ji: "This aura... it's a remnant shadow of Heavenly Dao! We must retreat!" Yet Chen Ji remained motionless. His gaze locked onto the stone gate, the turtle shell in his palm trembling violently, seemingly resonating with something.

dialogue.content: Just then, a voice materialized directly within Chen Ji's consciousness. Without source or direction, it seemed to emanate from the celestial dome itself: "A mere ant dares to pry into celestial secrets?" Chen Ji shuddered, his mind nearly destabilized. The voice continued: "A fragment of the Tianji Record... intriguing. Yet you should not have ventured here, should not have touched this gate." After a pause, the voice turned ice-cold: "Return now. What I have granted you is sufficient. One step further..." The voice abruptly ceased, yet the pressure exponentially multiplied.

choice.prompt: The warning from the Heavenly Dao's Eye echoed like thunder. Chen Ji felt unprecedented oppressive force. The stone gate was near, with the path back to reality behind him.

choices.text: Resisting the immense pressure, I push forward.

text.content: Chen Ji grits his teeth, advancing step by step. The pressure crushed down like a mountain, each step impossibly difficult. Blood seeped from his eye corners and nostrils, yet he refused to halt. "Chen Ji! Have you lost your mind!" Ye Qing cried out. She attempted to pull him back but was repelled by the overwhelming force. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out anxiously: "Young man, don't be reckless! That represents the Heavenly Dao's will. Your current cultivation cannot withstand it—" But Chen Ji could no longer hear anything. His vision narrowed to the stone gate alone, to the boundless celestial mysteries beyond.

choices.description: Heeding the warning and withdrawing, secretly continuing investigation
choices.visible_cost: Potentially missing out on fortuitous opportunities
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye might have already taken notice of you

dialogue.content: Chen Ji takes a deep breath, gradually stepping back. The oppressive force immediately diminishes. He lowers his gaze, burying all emotions deep within his eyes. His voice emerges unnervingly calm: "... I understand." Ye Qing freezes, clearly shocked by his seemingly effortless acquiescence. Yet Mo Xiansheng sighs inwardly: "Good, excellent. Maintaining composure in such a situation, you're more calculating than I anticipated." Chen Ji offers no response to Mo Xiansheng. Instead, he lifts his head, stealing one final glance at the stone gate. Silently, he commits every detail to memory. The Path to Ascension... he will inevitably return.

choices.text: Probing with the Tianji Record to test boundaries
choices.description: Depleting Heavenly Fate to discern the Heavenly Dao's Eye's true intentions

text.content: Just as he stepped back, a sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The power of the Turtle Shell surged once more, its silver radiance merging into the stone gate. This time, what he witnessed was not the future, but a long-sealed past—billions of years ago, within the celestial realm, an earth-shattering war unfolded. Countless immortals and deities fell, the Heavenly Dao shattered. A massive rift emerged, a wound between heaven and earth. And the "Path to Immortality"... was actually meant to seal that very rift! Deep within the abyss, a pair of eyes vaguely flickered, watching everything—the true form of the Heavenly Eye!

Chen Ji retreated three steps, and the suffocating pressure finally diminished. The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, this time with a hint of surprise: "Oh? To maintain mental clarity under my pressure... insect, you are rather interesting." After a pause, the voice turned meaningful: "But I warned you, do not advance further. The Tianji Record fragment on your body is a chess piece I left in the mortal realm ten thousand years ago... its choice of you is both your fortune and your doom."

Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul violently shuddered, letting out a sharp shriek within Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "What? The Tianji Record is its chess piece? Impossible! I am clearly Chen Xuan's left guardian, I clearly—" His voice cut off abruptly, as if having realized some terrifying truth. Chen Ji's heart sank, yet he did not reveal it. He merely lowered his head slightly, his voice calm without a trace of fluctuation: "Does the senior mean that... everything about me was already predestined?"

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye did not answer immediately. That gaze transcending all things examined Chen Ji, as if wanting to see through him. After a long while, the voice rang out again, carrying a hint of inexpressible meaning: "Predestined? No, there is no predestination in this world. But some things... were indeed placed on the chessboard long ago." The inscriptions on the stone gate suddenly flickered violently, a beam of golden light shooting from the door crack, shining directly on Chen Ji's chest. The Turtle Shell trembled intensely, as if trying to break free. "Your fate is intimately connected to this gate. But now... it is not yet time." The voice gradually faded, and with it, the pressure dissipated: "Go back, insect. Come see me again when you truly understand the Tianji Record."

text.content: The golden light vanished, the pressure completely dissipated. Chen Ji stood in place, his figure swaying slightly. Ye Qing hurried forward to support him, only to find his back already soaked through with cold sweat. "Are you... alright?" Her voice carried a trace of lingering fear, "That pressure just now... I thought I was going to die." Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze still fixed on the stone gate. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, this time carrying deep exhaustion: "Kid... the truth of the Tianji Record is probably far more complex than I imagined. Its choice of you... was it really just coincidence?" Chen Ji did not answer. He merely gripped the Turtle Shell in his palm tighter, a cold light unlike any before flickering in his eyes.

The stone gate slowly closed, the Path to Immortality sinking back into darkness. But Chen Ji knew that this gate had already remembered him. The Heavenly Eye's warning still echoed in his ears—the Tianji Record was a chess piece it had positioned ten thousand years ago, and he himself, perhaps from the very beginning, was merely a manipulated piece. This recognition sent a bone-deep chill through him. Yet at the same time, a thought sprouted quietly in his heart: since he was a chess piece, there must surely come a day when he would be discarded. He, Chen Ji, never accepted fate.
